summary.reception: In 2025, The New York Times ranked it as the best movie of the 21st century so far in a list based on a vote by readers, actors, and directors. On review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes, Parasite has an approval rating of 99% based on 485 reviews, with an average rating of 9.40/10. The website's critics consensus reads: "An urgent, brilliantly layered look at timely social themes, Parasite finds writer-director Bong Joon Ho in near-total command of his craft." The site ranked it fifth on their "300 Best Movies of All Time" list in 2025. On Metacritic, 56 compiled reviews from critics were identified as positive, giving the film a weighted average score of 97 out of 100. On the same site, Parasite was rated the best film of 2019 and ranked seventh among the films with the highest scores of the decade.
summary.story: Parasite (Korean: 기생충) is a 2019 South Korean black comedy thriller film directed by Bong Joon Ho, who co-wrote the screenplay with Han Jin-won. It stars Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-kyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-shik, Park So-dam, Jang Hye-jin, Park Myung-hoon, and Lee Jung-eun. The film follows a poor family who infiltrate the home and life of a wealthy family. As of February 2025, an HBO limited television series based on the film is in early development.
